authority.primary: Owner-provided full annotated PNG map (must be committed to this branch before geometry implementation)
authority.secondary: Editable SVG and this JSON are proposals, not an exact survey

workers.T1: Trips on the fallen shelf, recovers, physically reaches alarm button P and presses it off-screen. This action alone activates the alarm.
workers.T2: Jumps over shelf, continues pursuit, is blocked by cabinet.
workers.T3: Jumps over shelf, continues pursuit, is blocked by cabinet.

security.G1: Arrives after alarm activation with credible response time; blinded by extinguisher before being struck.
security.G2: Arrives after alarm activation with credible response time; blinded by extinguisher before being struck.

interactions.blue_X: Topple shelf; T1 falls, T2/T3 jump it. No automatic alarm.
interactions.purple_X: Topple cabinet and physically block T2/T3 with no bypass.
interactions.green_X: Pick up and discharge extinguisher; blind G1/G2 temporarily, then strike them.

camera.return_contract: Return to the same physical player position and orientation; no teleport or involuntary turn.
